name: Bread
overview: Scripture reveals bread as a vital element of daily life and worship, symbolizing sustenance and God's provision. Abraham's preparation of fine meal cakes (Genesis 18:6) and the baking of unleavened bread during a feast (Genesis 19:3) illustrate bread's role in hospitality and sacred occasions. The detailed references to kneading troughs and dough in Exodus (Exodus 8:3; 12:34) emphasize the careful preparation involved, while the gathering of manna each morning (Exodus 16:21) highlights God's miraculous provision for His people. Bread, whether leavened or unleavened, is foundational not only physically but spiritually, pointing to dependence on God as the true Bread of Life.
